mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) reflects strong economic growth, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, which could lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) also increases, it may signal inefficiencies in labor utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tighter monetary policy, which could lead to decreased borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects stronger demand in the housing market, which could lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weaker consumer demand, which could lead to decreased corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects weaker supply chain activity, which could lead to decreased economic output and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during periods of industrial production slowdown (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL) could lead to tighter monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
